statusEffects.name: Stun
statusEffects.description: Prevents movement. Cannot be applied again until immunityAfter seconds after it ends; a stunning hit during that time deals 4% of the max HP instead (1/3 on bosses, at most 4x the hit).

statusEffects.name: Bleed
statusEffects.description: Physical damage every tick (only the first stack can be resisted): value % of the hit that caused it. At 5 stacks the stacks are removed and the enemy loses 4% of its max HP (1/3 on bosses, at most 10x the hit).

statusEffects.name: Armor Break
statusEffects.description: Removes value points of effective defense.

statusEffects.name: Hunter's Mark
statusEffects.description: Takes value % more damage from Crossbow towers per stack (max 5, shared by all Crossbows). At 5 stacks every Crossbow hit also deals 1% of the current HP (1/3 on bosses, at most 10x the hit).

statusEffects.name: Arcane Vulnerability
statusEffects.description: Takes value % more magic damage per stack (max 5).

towerEffects.name: Piercing Bolt
towerEffects.description: The bolt goes on to hit up to 4 more enemies nearby.

towerEffects.name: Bleeding Bolt
towerEffects.description: Bleed: 20% of the hit as physical damage every second for 4 s (stacks 5 times). At 5 stacks the bleed bursts for 4% of the max HP (1/3 on bosses, at most 10x the hit).

towerEffects.name: Hunter's Mark
towerEffects.description: The target takes +50% Crossbow damage per stack for 5 s (max 5 stacks, shared by all Crossbows). At 5 stacks every Crossbow hit also deals 1% of the current HP (1/3 on bosses, at most 10x the hit).

towerEffects.name: Frost Explosion
towerEffects.description: Every enemy in the explosion is slowed by 35% for 2.5 s.

towerEffects.name: Chain Lightning
towerEffects.description: Lightning jumps to up to 5 more enemies for 80% damage, even when the shot hits no enemy.

towerEffects.name: Arcane Vulnerability
towerEffects.description: Enemies hit take +30% magic damage per stack for 4 s (max 5 stacks).

towerEffects.name: Shockwave
towerEffects.description: Enemies hit are stunned for 0.3 s (then immune to stun for 0.5 s). A stunned or immune enemy takes 4% of its max HP instead (1/3 on bosses, at most 4x the hit).

towerEffects.name: Heavy Impact
towerEffects.description: Bonus damage equal to 6% of the target's max HP (at most 5 normal hits, 1/3 on bosses).

towerEffects.name: Armor Break
towerEffects.description: Enemies hit lose 20 defense for 4 s.
